"""Original CARLA entrypoint for one reviewed signal case."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from construction import CASE_PROFILES, CAMERAS
from signal_capture import capture


def reviewed_scene(path, case):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    scene = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if scene.get("source_kind") != "reviewed_original_native_scene" or \
            scene.get("case_id") != case or scene.get("cell_id") != "C158196" or \
            scene.get("actor") != "motor_vehicle_driver":
        raise ValueError("reviewed exact Native scene identity missing")
    if scene.get("map_name") is None or len(scene.get("map_sha256", "")) != 64:
        raise ValueError("reviewed OpenDRIVE map identity missing")
    if not isinstance(scene.get("intersection_polygon_xy"), list) or \
            len(scene["intersection_polygon_xy"]) < 3:
        raise ValueError("surveyed intersection polygon missing")
    if not scene.get("route_native_lanes") or not isinstance(scene.get("approach_yaw_deg"), (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("reviewed route Native lanes or heading missing")
    if scene.get("duration_frames") != 900 or scene.get("rate_hz") != 20 or \
            tuple(scene.get("cameras", ())) != CAMERAS:
        raise ValueError("original capture profile changed")
    refs = ("intersection_polygon_source", "route_connectivity_source",
            "device_route_binding_source", "official_device_source")
    if case == "yellow_non_alone":
        refs += ("companion_device_source",)
    if case == "red_other_route":
        refs += ("other_route_device_source",)
    for label in refs:
        ref = scene.get(label)
        if not isinstance(ref, dict) or not ref.get("path") or not ref.get("sha256"):
            raise ValueError("missing reviewed source: " + label)
        target = (path.parent / ref["path"]).resolve()
        if not target.is_relative_to(path.parent) or not target.is_file() or \
                hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != ref["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("reviewed source seal mismatch: " + label)
    if scene["intersection_polygon_source"]["sha256"] != scene["intersection_polygon_sha256"] or \
            scene["route_connectivity_source"]["sha256"] != scene["route_connectivity_sha256"] or \
            scene["official_device_source"]["sha256"] != scene["official_device_sha256"] or \
            scene["device_route_binding_source"]["sha256"] != scene["signal_route_binding_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("reviewed scene/source hashes disagree")
    if case == "yellow_non_alone" and scene["companion_device_source"]["sha256"] != \
            scene["companion_device_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("companion source hash differs")
    if case == "red_other_route" and (scene["other_route_device_source"]["sha256"] !=
                                      scene.get("other_route_device_sha256") or
                                      not scene.get("other_route_native_lanes")):
        raise ValueError("other-route source binding differs")
    return scene


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--case", choices=tuple(CASE_PROFILES))
    parser.add_argument("--scene", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--host")
    parser.add_argument("--port")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--adapter-module")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "config.json"
    if config_path.is_file():
        config = json.loads(config_path.read_text())
        selected = config["selected_case_id"].removeprefix(config["assignment_id"] + "__")
        if args.case is not None and args.case != selected:
            raise ValueError("selected exact case differs from bundled configuration")
        args.case = selected
    if args.case not in CASE_PROFILES:
        raise ValueError("exact bundled signal case missing")
    if args.check:
        print("exact signal runner static check passed: " + args.case)
        return
    if not args.host or not args.port or args.output_dir is None:
        raise ValueError("Native host, port and owned output directory required")
    packet = args.scene or os.environ.get("C158196_REVIEWED_SCENE")
    if not packet:
        raise ValueError("reviewed Native scene packet required")
    scene = reviewed_scene(packet, args.case)
    name = args.adapter_module or os.environ.get("C158196_NATIVE_ADAPTER_MODULE") or \
        "signal_carla_adapter"
    adapter = importlib.import_module(name).create_adapter(args.host, args.port, scene)
    capture(adapter, scene, args.case, args.output_dir)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Materialized case identity and runner smoke test."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class BundleTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_case_static_runner(self):
        config = json.loads((ROOT / "config.json").read_text())
        self.assertTrue(config["selected_case_id"].startswith(config["assignment_id"] + "__"))
        self.assertEqual((config["rate_hz"], config["duration_s"]), (20, 45))
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "runner.py"), "--check"],
                                cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("static check passed", result.stdout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Saved-only signal and body-entry measurements; no legal verdict."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from package_spec import CAMERA_NAMES
from signal_measurement import measure


def need(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def required(root, name):
    path = root / name
    if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    return path


def source_sealed_signal_measurement(value):
    """Retain a concrete source measurement without a legal cutoff."""
    return value


def analyze(attempt):
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    config = json.loads(required(root, "config.json").read_text())
    case_id = config["selected_case_id"]
    slug = case_id.removeprefix(config["assignment_id"] + "__")
    packet_path = required(root, "original-signal-packet.json")
    packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text())
    receipt_path = required(root, "original-source-receipt.json")
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
    diagnostic = receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture") is True
    need((receipt.get("source_kind") == "synthetic_diagnostic_fixture" if diagnostic else
          receipt.get("source_kind") == "original_native_capture"),
         "source provenance differs from diagnostic/original claim")
    need(receipt.get("signal_packet_sha256") == sha(packet_path) and
         receipt.get("case") == slug, "signal source packet/receipt mismatch")
    required(root, "trace.jsonl")
    required(root, "video_frames.jsonl")
    profile = ("yellow_non_alone" if slug == "yellow_non_alone" else
               "red_other_route" if slug == "red_other_route" else
               "steady_yellow_alone")
    observed = measure(packet, expected_frames=len(packet["frames"]), case_profile=profile)
    sources = {name: sha(required(root, name)) for name in
               ("original-signal-packet.json", "original-source-receipt.json",
                "trace.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl")}
    phase = observed["phase_transitions"]
    bracket = observed["entry_bracket"]
    values = {
        "selected_facing_signal_sequence": {"selected_route_id": observed["selected_route_id"],
                                            "selected_signal_id": observed["selected_signal_id"],
                                            "phase_transitions": phase,
                                            "yellow_alone_observed": observed["yellow_alone_observed"],
                                            "companion_indication_frames": observed["companion_indication_frames"]},
        "intersection_entry_bracket": {"entry_bracket": bracket,
                                       "entry_observation": observed["entry_observation"],
                                       "initially_inside": observed["initially_inside_intersection"]},
        "signal_vs_entry": {"phase_transitions": phase, "entry_bracket": bracket,
                            "entry_observation": observed["entry_observation"],
                            "legal_judgment": "unresolved"},
        "comparison_isolation": {"selected_route_id": observed["selected_route_id"],
                                 "other_route_red_frames": observed["other_route_red_frames"],
                                 "source_provenance": receipt["source_kind"]},
        "entry_governance": {"selected_signal_id": observed["selected_signal_id"],
                             "entry_observation": observed["entry_observation"],
                             "other_route_red_frames": observed["other_route_red_frames"]},
    }
    contract_sources = {name: sources[name] for name in
                        ("original-signal-packet.json", "original-source-receipt.json",
                         "trace.jsonl")}
    measurements = {name: {"method": "source_sealed_signal_measurement",
                           "value": source_sealed_signal_measurement(value),
                           "sources": contract_sources}
                    for name, value in values.items()}
    evidence = []
    for channel in config["case"]["recording_description"]["channels"]:
        name = channel["name"]
        data = ([{"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": row.get("carla_frame")}
                 for row in (json.loads(line) for line in
                             required(root, "video_frames.jsonl").read_text().splitlines())]
                if name == "camera_frame_identity" else
                [{"time_s": row["time_s"], "value":
                  values[name] if name != "intersection_entry_bracket" else
                  {"signed_distance_m": row["ego_front_signed_distance_m"],
                   "entry_observation": observed["entry_observation"]}}
                 for row in packet["frames"]])
        target = root / ("channel-" + name + ".jsonl")
        encoded = "".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in data)
        if target.exists():
            need(target.read_text() == encoded, "derived channel differs from source replay")
        else:
            target.write_text(encoded)
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": channel["unit"], "reference": target.name})
    context = root / "channel-reviewed_native_signal_scene.json"
    content = json.dumps({"reviewed_native_signal_scene": {
        "route": observed["selected_route_id"],
        "signal": observed["selected_signal_id"],
        "source_hashes": sources}}, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
    if context.exists():
        need(context.read_text() == content, "reviewed source context changed")
    else:
        context.write_text(content)
    evidence.append({"name": "reviewed_native_signal_scene", "unit": "source record",
                     "reference": context.name})
    expected = ("no_entry" if slug in ("stops_red", "yellow_non_alone") else
                "red_both_samples" if slug == "enters_red" else
                "yellow_both_samples")
    matched = observed["entry_observation"] == expected
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, write_result
    target_check = {"target": "selected route signal and surveyed body entry",
                    "requested": expected, "measured": observed["entry_observation"],
                    "method": "original 20 Hz official head and front/polygon bracket",
                    "tolerance": 0, "matched": matched,
                    "physical_cause_confirmed": False, "cause_evidence": sources}
    result = {"case_id": case_id, "measured_values": values,
        "target_checks": [target_check], "setup_confirmed": False,
        "behavior_attempted": False, "maneuver_completed": False,
        "termination_reason": "saved source measurement; physical and legal review pending",
        "physical_failure_flags": ["physical_acceptance_unverified"],
        "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
        "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in CAMERA_NAMES],
        "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
        "recording_description": config["case"]["recording_description"],
        "recording_evidence": evidence, "realized_observables": {},
        "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
        "legal_verdict_claimed": False}
    result = physical_result(root, result)
    write_result(root, result)
    return {"format": "worker-analysis-report", "case_id": case_id,
            "analysis_complete": True, "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic,
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False, "legal_verdict_claimed": False,
            "measurements": measurements, "physical_checks": result["physical_checks"],
            "realized_observables": result["realized_observables"],
            "limitations": ["Original phase and entry are observations, not legal findings."]}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists():
        raise ValueError("retain prior analysis report")
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(analyze(args.attempt), indent=2) + "\n")

"""Record one original Native signal encounter at 20 Hz for 900 frames.

The adapter must return live signal, body, and camera observations. This module
does not infer a statutory verdict from a requested entry phase.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

from construction import CAMERAS, construct
from signal_measurement import measure


def need(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def capture(adapter, scene, case, destination):
    """Capture an original attempt; keep a failed attempt out of the destination."""
    destination = Path(destination)
    need(not destination.exists(), "original destination already exists")
    need(getattr(adapter, "native_attested", False) is True,
         "attested Native adapter required")
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stage = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="signal-original-", dir=destination.parent))
    owned = []
    try:
        built = construct(adapter, scene, case)
        owned.append(built["ego"])
        frame_dirs = {name: stage / ("frames-" + name) for name in CAMERAS}
        for folder in frame_dirs.values():
            folder.mkdir()
        rows = []
        frame_map = []
        previous = None
        for index in range(900):
            snapshot = adapter.tick(built)
            native_frame, native_time = snapshot.get("frame"), snapshot.get("time_s")
            need(type(native_frame) is int and type(native_time) in (int, float),
                 "Native frame/time required")
            if previous is not None:
                need(native_frame == previous[0] + 1 and
                     abs(native_time - previous[1] - .05) <= .002,
                     "original Native 20 Hz join failed")
            previous = native_frame, native_time
            observed = adapter.read_signal_row(native_frame, built, scene)
            need(observed.get("origin") == "native_world_snapshot" and
                 observed.get("native_frame") == native_frame and
                 observed.get("native_time_s") == native_time,
                 "original signal/body readback missing")
            row = dict(observed)
            row.pop("origin")
            row["frame"] = row["source_frame"] = index
            row["time_s"] = index / 20.0
            pixels = adapter.read_cameras(native_frame, built)
            need(isinstance(pixels, dict) and set(pixels) == set(CAMERAS),
                 "four original cameras required")
            hashes = {}
            for name in CAMERAS:
                image = pixels[name]
                raw = image.get("png")
                need(image.get("frame") == native_frame and
                     isinstance(raw, bytes) and raw.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"),
                     "original camera frame or pixel bytes missing: " + name)
                (frame_dirs[name] / f"{index:04d}.png").write_bytes(raw)
                hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
            rows.append(row)
            frame_map.append({"video_frame": index, "carla_frame": native_frame,
                              "native_frame": native_frame, "time_s": native_time,
                              "camera_png_sha256": hashes})
        packet = {"layout": scene["layout"], "route_id": scene["selected_route_id"],
                  "signal_id": scene["selected_signal_id"], "frames": rows}
        packet.update(adapter.source_bindings(scene))
        geometry = stage / "native-ego-geometry.jsonl"
        geometry_records = []
        for row in rows:
            vertices = row.pop("ego_vertices")
            row["position_m"] = [sum(point[axis] for point in vertices) / 8
                                 for axis in (0, 1, 2)]
            geometry_records.append({"frame": row["frame"],
                                     "native_frame": row["native_frame"],
                                     "ego_vertices": vertices,
                                     "ego_front_signed_distance_m":
                                     row["ego_front_signed_distance_m"]})
        geometry.write_text("".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
                                    for row in geometry_records), encoding="utf-8")
        geometry_source = {"path": geometry.name, "sha256": sha(geometry)}
        for row in rows:
            row["ego_geometry_source"] = geometry_source
        trace_rows = [{"frame": row["native_frame"], "time_s": row["native_time_s"],
                       "position": {"x": row["position_m"][0],
                                    "y": row["position_m"][1],
                                    "z": row["position_m"][2]},
                       "position_m": row["position_m"],
                       "heading_deg": row["heading_deg"],
                       "speed_mps": row["speed_mps"],
                       "speed_mph": row["speed_mps"] / 0.44704}
                      for row in rows]
        (stage / "trace.jsonl").write_text(
            "".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in trace_rows),
            encoding="utf-8")
        packet["native_result"] = {"path": "trace.jsonl", "sha256": sha(stage / "trace.jsonl")}
        write(stage / "original-signal-packet.json", packet)
        profile = ("yellow_non_alone" if case == "yellow_non_alone" else
                   "red_other_route" if case == "red_other_route" else
                   "steady_yellow_alone")
        measurement = measure(packet, case_profile=profile)
        write(stage / "signal-measurement.json", measurement)
        (stage / "video_frames.jsonl").write_text(
            "".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in frame_map),
            encoding="utf-8")
        videos = {}
        for name, folder in frame_dirs.items():
            path = stage / (name + ".mkv")
            subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-nostdin", "-framerate", "20",
                            "-i", str(folder / "%04d.png"), "-frames:v", "900",
                            "-c:v", "ffv1", str(path)], check=True,
                           stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
            videos[name] = {"path": path.name, "sha256": sha(path),
                            "frame_count": 900}
            shutil.rmtree(folder)
        write(stage / "original-source-receipt.json",
              {"source_kind": "original_native_capture", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
               "case": case, "frame_count": 900, "fps": 20,
               "signal_packet_sha256": sha(stage / "original-signal-packet.json"),
               "trace_sha256": sha(stage / "trace.jsonl"),
               "frame_map_sha256": sha(stage / "video_frames.jsonl"),
               "cameras": videos, "physical_acceptance": False,
               "legal_verdict": None})
        os.replace(stage, destination)
        return measurement
    except BaseException:
        shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            adapter.brake()
        finally:
            try:
                for actor in reversed(owned):
                    adapter.destroy(actor)
            finally:
                adapter.restore()

"""Independent original signal capture source and full-video decode audit."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess


CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def need(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]


def decode(video, *, probe=None, decoder=None):
    if probe is None:
        probe = lambda command: subprocess.run(command, check=True, text=True,
                                                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if decoder is None:
        decoder = lambda command: subprocess.run(command, check=True,
                                                  stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                                  stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    result = probe(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0",
                    "-count_frames", "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_frames,r_frame_rate",
                    "-of", "json", str(video)])
    data = json.loads(result.stdout)
    streams = data.get("streams", [])
    need(len(streams) == 1 and streams[0].get("r_frame_rate") == "20/1" and
         int(streams[0].get("nb_read_frames", 0)) == 900,
         "original camera has wrong frame count or rate")
    decoder(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-nostdin", "-i", str(video),
             "-f", "null", "-"])


def audit(attempt, case, *, probe=None, decoder=None):
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    receipt_path = attempt / "original-source-receipt.json"
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
    need(receipt.get("source_kind") == "original_native_capture" and
         receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture") is False and receipt.get("case") == case,
         "original Native source receipt mismatch")
    need(receipt.get("fps") == 20 and receipt.get("frame_count") == 900,
         "original 20 Hz duration missing")
    packet_path = attempt / "original-signal-packet.json"
    trace_path = attempt / "trace.jsonl"
    frame_map_path = attempt / "video_frames.jsonl"
    for path, key in ((packet_path, "signal_packet_sha256"),
                      (trace_path, "trace_sha256"),
                      (frame_map_path, "frame_map_sha256")):
        need(path.is_file() and sha(path) == receipt.get(key),
             "original source hash mismatch: " + path.name)
    packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text())
    trace = rows(trace_path)
    mapping = rows(frame_map_path)
    geometry = attempt / "native-ego-geometry.jsonl"
    need(len(trace) == len(mapping) == len(packet.get("frames", [])) == 900 and
         geometry.is_file(), "original frame or body history incomplete")
    geometry_rows = rows(geometry)
    need(len(geometry_rows) == 900, "original body geometry incomplete")
    geometry_sha = sha(geometry)
    native_previous = None
    for index, (row, mapped, body) in enumerate(zip(trace, mapping, geometry_rows)):
        packet_row = packet["frames"][index]
        need(packet_row.get("frame") == index and
             packet_row.get("source_frame") == index and mapped.get("video_frame") == index and
             row.get("frame") == packet_row.get("native_frame") ==
             mapped.get("native_frame") == mapped.get("carla_frame") and
             row.get("time_s") == packet_row.get("native_time_s") == mapped.get("time_s") and
             body.get("frame") == index and
             body.get("native_frame") == row.get("frame") and
             len(body.get("ego_vertices", [])) == 8,
             "original signal/body/video frame join differs")
        ref = packet_row.get("ego_geometry_source", {})
        need(ref.get("path") == geometry.name and ref.get("sha256") == geometry_sha,
             "original body geometry source hash differs")
        if native_previous is not None:
            need(row["frame"] == native_previous[0] + 1 and
                 abs(row["time_s"] - native_previous[1] - .05) <= .002,
                 "original Native frame/time cadence differs")
        native_previous = row["frame"], row["time_s"]
    camera_refs = receipt.get("cameras")
    need(isinstance(camera_refs, dict) and set(camera_refs) == set(CAMERAS),
         "four original videos missing")
    for name in CAMERAS:
        ref = camera_refs[name]
        path = (attempt / ref["path"]).resolve()
        need(path.parent == attempt and path.is_file() and sha(path) == ref["sha256"] and
             ref.get("frame_count") == 900, "original camera source hash differs: " + name)
        decode(path, probe=probe, decoder=decoder)
    return {"format": "signal-original-source-audit", "case": case,
            "receipt_sha256": sha(receipt_path), "frame_count": 900,
            "full_decode": True, "source_verified": True,
            "actual_pixels_reviewed": False, "legal_verdict": None}

"""Lazy CARLA bridge for source-reviewed NRS 484B.307(6)(a) capture.

The local scene packet must identify an OpenDRIVE map, a surveyed entry
polygon, the route waypoints, and official Native traffic-light actor IDs.
Live world readback supplies every observed indication and body position.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from io import BytesIO
import math
from pathlib import Path
from queue import Empty, Queue

from construction import CAMERAS


def need(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def inside_polygon(x, y, polygon):
    need(len(polygon) >= 3, "surveyed intersection polygon missing")
    inside = False
    j = len(polygon) - 1
    for i, point in enumerate(polygon):
        prior = polygon[j]
        if (point[1] > y) != (prior[1] > y):
            crossing = (prior[0] - point[0]) * (y - point[1]) / (prior[1] - point[1]) + point[0]
            if x < crossing:
                inside = not inside
        j = i
    return inside


def signed_distance(x, y, polygon):
    minimum = float("inf")
    for a, b in zip(polygon, polygon[1:] + polygon[:1]):
        dx, dy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
        length = dx * dx + dy * dy
        need(length > 0, "degenerate surveyed intersection polygon")
        t = max(0.0, min(1.0, ((x - a[0]) * dx + (y - a[1]) * dy) / length))
        minimum = min(minimum, math.hypot(x - (a[0] + t * dx), y - (a[1] + t * dy)))
    return minimum if inside_polygon(x, y, polygon) else -minimum


def heading_to(source, target):
    return math.degrees(math.atan2(target.y - source.y, target.x - source.x))


class CarlaSignalAdapter:
    native_attested = True

    def __init__(self, host, port, scene, *, carla_module=None):
        if carla_module is None:
            import carla as carla_module
        self.carla = carla_module
        self.client = carla_module.Client(str(host), int(port))
        self.client.set_timeout(20.0)
        self.world = self.client.get_world()
        self.scene = scene
        self.settings_before = self.world.get_settings()
        self.owned = []
        self.sensors = {}
        self.queues = {}
        self.signals = {}
        self.original_signal_state = {}
        self.ego = None
        self.index = -1
        self.last_frame = None
        self.last_time = None
        self.profile = None

    def configure_world(self, map_sha256, *, fixed_delta_seconds):
        need(fixed_delta_seconds == .05, "20 Hz Native clock required")
        native_map = self.world.get_map()
        need(native_map.name == self.scene.get("map_name"), "reviewed Native map name differs")
        observed_hash = hashlib.sha256(native_map.to_opendrive().encode()).hexdigest()
        need(observed_hash == map_sha256, "reviewed OpenDRIVE map hash differs")
        settings = self.world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = .05
        self.world.apply_settings(settings)

    def _location(self, xyz):
        return self.carla.Location(x=float(xyz[0]), y=float(xyz[1]),
                                   z=float(xyz[2]) if len(xyz) > 2 else 0.0)

    def spawn_ego(self, blueprint_id, spawn):
        need(str(blueprint_id).startswith("vehicle."), "motor-vehicle blueprint required")
        blueprint = self.world.get_blueprint_library().find(blueprint_id)
        transform = self.carla.Transform(self._location(spawn),
                                         self.carla.Rotation(yaw=float(self.scene["approach_yaw_deg"])))
        actor = self.world.try_spawn_actor(blueprint, transform)
        need(actor is not None and actor.type_id == blueprint_id, "Native ego spawn failed")
        self.ego = actor
        self.owned.append(actor)
        return actor

    def _bind_signal(self, signal_id, route_id):
        need(route_id in {self.scene["selected_route_id"], self.scene.get("other_route_id")},
             "wrong surveyed route binding")
        actor = self.world.get_actor(int(signal_id))
        need(actor is not None and actor.type_id == "traffic.traffic_light",
             "official Native traffic light absent")
        affected = actor.get_affected_lane_waypoints()
        reviewed = (self.scene["other_route_native_lanes"] if
                    route_id == self.scene.get("other_route_id") else
                    self.scene["route_native_lanes"])
        need(any([waypoint.road_id, waypoint.lane_id] in reviewed
                 for waypoint in affected), "official head does not govern selected route")
        self.signals[str(signal_id)] = actor
        self.original_signal_state[str(signal_id)] = actor.get_state()
        return {"kind": "vehicular", "official": True, "facing_route_id": route_id,
                "source_sha256": (self.scene["other_route_device_sha256"]
                                  if str(signal_id) == str(self.scene.get("other_route_signal_id"))
                                  else self.scene["companion_device_sha256"]
                                  if str(signal_id) == str(self.scene.get("companion_signal_id"))
                                  else self.scene["official_device_sha256"]),
                "actor": actor}

    def bind_official_signal(self, signal_id, route_id):
        return self._bind_signal(signal_id, route_id)

    def bind_companion_signal(self, signal_id, route_id):
        return self._bind_signal(signal_id, route_id)

    def bind_other_route_signal(self, signal_id, route_id):
        return self._bind_signal(signal_id, route_id)

    def program_signal(self, signal, *, sequence, profile):
        need(sequence == ("green", "yellow", "red"), "wrong original signal sequence")
        signal["actor"].freeze(True)
        self.profile = profile

    def program_companion_signal(self, companion, *, active_during):
        need(active_during == "yellow", "companion lamp timing changed")
        companion["actor"].freeze(True)

    def program_other_route_signal(self, other, *, state):
        need(state == "red", "other-route comparison indication changed")
        other["actor"].freeze(True)

    def set_route_controller(self, ego, waypoints, *, behavior):
        need(len(waypoints) >= 3, "reviewed route missing")
        self.behavior = behavior
        self.route = [self._location(point) for point in waypoints]

    def attach_camera(self, ego, name):
        need(name in CAMERAS and name not in self.sensors, "unexpected or duplicate camera")
        from worker_exchange.capture import PROFILE
        if name == "overview":
            width, height = PROFILE["overview"]
        else:
            width, height = PROFILE["detail_views"][CAMERAS.index(name) - 1]
        blueprint = self.world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
        blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(width))
        blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(height))
        blueprint.set_attribute("sensor_tick", "0.05")
        offset = {"overview": (-15, 0, 22), "approach": (-9, 4, 4),
                  "reference_corner": (5, 6, 7), "driver_reference": (0, 0, 2)}[name]
        sensor = self.world.spawn_actor(blueprint, self.carla.Transform(
            self.carla.Location(*offset)), attach_to=ego)
        queue = Queue()
        sensor.listen(queue.put)
        self.owned.append(sensor)
        self.sensors[name] = sensor
        self.queues[name] = queue

    def _phase(self):
        green_end = self.scene.get("green_end_frame", 100)
        yellow_end = self.scene.get("yellow_end_frame", 160)
        need(type(green_end) is int and type(yellow_end) is int and
             1 <= green_end < yellow_end < 900 and yellow_end - green_end <= 100,
             "reviewed phase schedule invalid")
        if self.index < green_end:
            return "green"
        return "yellow" if self.index < yellow_end else "red"

    def _control(self):
        ego = self.ego
        need(ego is not None, "Native ego missing")
        target = self.route[min(len(self.route) - 1, max(1, self.index // 150 + 1))]
        location = ego.get_location()
        yaw = ego.get_transform().rotation.yaw
        error = (heading_to(location, target) - yaw + 180) % 360 - 180
        steer = max(-.65, min(.65, error / 45))
        speed = ego.get_velocity()
        speed_mps = math.sqrt(speed.x * speed.x + speed.y * speed.y + speed.z * speed.z)
        target_speed = {"yellow": 9, "yellow_before_red": 9,
                        "red": 5, "other_route_red": 9,
                        "yellow_to_red": 8, "none": 0,
                        "companion_indication": 0}.get(self.profile, 7)
        if self.behavior == "stop_before_entry":
            vertices = ego.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(ego.get_transform())
            ahead = max(vertices, key=lambda point: (point.x - location.x) *
                        math.cos(math.radians(yaw)) + (point.y - location.y) *
                        math.sin(math.radians(yaw)))
            distance = signed_distance(ahead.x, ahead.y,
                                       self.scene["intersection_polygon_xy"])
            if distance >= -max(4.0, speed_mps * 1.5):
                target_speed = 0
        throttle = max(0.0, min(.6, (target_speed - speed_mps) * .2))
        brake = max(0.0, min(.8, (speed_mps - target_speed) * .3))
        ego.apply_control(self.carla.VehicleControl(throttle=throttle, brake=brake,
                                                    steer=steer))

    def tick(self, built):
        self.index += 1
        phase = self._phase()
        selected = self.signals[str(self.scene["selected_signal_id"])]
        selected.set_state({"green": self.carla.TrafficLightState.Green,
                            "yellow": self.carla.TrafficLightState.Yellow,
                            "red": self.carla.TrafficLightState.Red}[phase])
        companion_id = self.scene.get("companion_signal_id")
        if self.profile == "companion_indication" and companion_id is not None:
            companion = self.signals[str(companion_id)]
            companion.set_state(self.carla.TrafficLightState.Green if phase == "yellow"
                                else self.carla.TrafficLightState.Red)
        other_id = self.scene.get("other_route_signal_id")
        if self.profile == "other_route_red" and other_id is not None:
            self.signals[str(other_id)].set_state(self.carla.TrafficLightState.Red)
        self._control()
        frame = self.world.tick()
        snapshot = self.world.get_snapshot()
        need(snapshot.frame == frame, "Native world snapshot differs from tick")
        self.last_frame = frame
        self.last_time = snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds
        return {"frame": frame, "time_s": self.last_time}

    def read_signal_row(self, frame, built, scene):
        need(frame == self.last_frame, "signal readback not from current Native frame")
        ego = self.ego
        vertices = ego.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(ego.get_transform())
        need(len(vertices) == 8, "ego body vertices missing")
        yaw = math.radians(ego.get_transform().rotation.yaw)
        forward = (math.cos(yaw), math.sin(yaw))
        center = ego.get_location()
        front = max(vertices, key=lambda point: (point.x - center.x) * forward[0] +
                    (point.y - center.y) * forward[1])
        selected_id = str(scene["selected_signal_id"])
        selected = self.signals[selected_id]
        velocity = ego.get_velocity()
        speed_mps = math.sqrt(velocity.x ** 2 + velocity.y ** 2 + velocity.z ** 2)
        state = str(selected.get_state()).split(".")[-1].lower()
        need(state in {"green", "yellow", "red"}, "Native selected signal state invalid")
        companions = []
        companion_id = scene.get("companion_signal_id")
        if self.profile == "companion_indication" and companion_id is not None and state == "yellow":
            lamp = self.signals[str(companion_id)].get_state()
            if lamp == self.carla.TrafficLightState.Green:
                companions = [str(companion_id)]
        signals = [{"signal_id": selected_id,
                    "route_id": scene["selected_route_id"], "kind": "vehicular",
                    "official": True, "facing_ego": True, "state": state,
                    "flashing": False, "companion_lamps_on": companions,
                    "source": scene["official_device_source"]}]
        other_id = scene.get("other_route_signal_id")
        if self.profile == "other_route_red" and other_id is not None:
            other = self.signals[str(other_id)]
            signals.append({"signal_id": str(other_id), "route_id": scene["other_route_id"],
                            "kind": "vehicular", "official": True, "facing_ego": False,
                            "state": str(other.get_state()).split(".")[-1].lower(),
                            "source": scene["other_route_device_source"]})
        return {"origin": "native_world_snapshot", "native_frame": frame,
                "native_time_s": self.last_time,
                "heading_deg": ego.get_transform().rotation.yaw,
                "speed_mps": speed_mps,
                "ego_front_signed_distance_m": signed_distance(front.x, front.y,
                                                                  scene["intersection_polygon_xy"]),
                "ego_vertices": [[point.x, point.y, point.z] for point in vertices],
                "signals": signals}

    def read_cameras(self, frame, built):
        from PIL import Image
        result = {}
        for name in CAMERAS:
            image = None
            for _ in range(8):
                try:
                    candidate = self.queues[name].get(timeout=2)
                except Empty as error:
                    raise ValueError("Native camera frame absent: " + name) from error
                if candidate.frame == frame:
                    image = candidate
                    break
                need(candidate.frame < frame, "Native camera advanced past world frame")
            need(image is not None, "Native camera frame synchronization failed")
            raw = Image.frombytes("RGBA", (image.width, image.height),
                                  bytes(image.raw_data), "raw", "BGRA").convert("RGB")
            buffer = BytesIO()
            raw.save(buffer, format="PNG")
            result[name] = {"frame": frame, "png": buffer.getvalue()}
        return result

    def source_bindings(self, scene):
        return {"intersection_polygon": scene["intersection_polygon_source"],
                "route_connectivity": scene["route_connectivity_source"],
                "device_route_binding": scene["device_route_binding_source"]}

    def brake(self):
        if self.ego is not None and self.ego.is_alive:
            self.ego.apply_control(self.carla.VehicleControl(throttle=0, brake=1))

    def destroy(self, actor):
        if getattr(actor, "is_alive", False):
            actor.destroy()

    def restore(self):
        for actor in reversed(self.owned):
            self.destroy(actor)
        for signal_id, actor in self.signals.items():
            if actor.is_alive:
                actor.set_state(self.original_signal_state[signal_id])
                actor.freeze(False)
        self.world.apply_settings(self.settings_before)


def create_adapter(host, port, scene):
    return CarlaSignalAdapter(host, port, scene)

"""Source-gated scene construction plan for a Native CARLA adapter.

An adapter implements the five methods called below. The source gates prevent
synthetic indications or scene annotations substituting for actual signal heads.
"""
from __future__ import annotations


class ConstructionError(ValueError):
    pass


CASE_PROFILES = {
    "enters_yellow": {"behavior": "traverse", "entry_phase": "yellow"},
    "enters_red": {"behavior": "traverse", "entry_phase": "red"},
    "inside_on_red": {"behavior": "traverse", "entry_phase": "yellow_before_red"},
    "red_other_route": {"behavior": "traverse", "entry_phase": "other_route_red"},
    "yellow_red": {"behavior": "traverse", "entry_phase": "yellow_to_red"},
    "stops_red": {"behavior": "stop_before_entry", "entry_phase": "none"},
    "yellow_non_alone": {"behavior": "stop_before_entry", "entry_phase": "companion_indication"},
}
CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def construct(adapter, scene: dict, case: str) -> dict:
    if case not in CASE_PROFILES:
        raise ConstructionError("unknown exact case")
    required = ("map_sha256", "intersection_polygon_sha256", "route_connectivity_sha256",
                "ego_blueprint", "selected_route_id", "selected_signal_id", "official_device_sha256",
                "signal_route_binding_sha256", "approach_spawn", "route_waypoints")
    if any(not scene.get(key) for key in required):
        raise ConstructionError("missing source-bound map, device, route, or ego configuration")
    if scene.get("layout") != "one_way_to_two_way_intersection":
        raise ConstructionError("wrong layout")
    if scene.get("signal_kind") != "vehicular" or scene.get("signal_facing_route_id") != scene["selected_route_id"]:
        raise ConstructionError("official facing vehicle signal not bound to ego route")
    if len(scene["route_waypoints"]) < 3 or scene.get("route_direction_sequence") != ["one_way", "intersection", "two_way"]:
        raise ConstructionError("one-way-to-two-way route connectivity unverified")
    if scene.get("duration_frames") != 900 or scene.get("rate_hz") != 20 or tuple(scene.get("cameras", ())) != CAMERAS:
        raise ConstructionError("capture profile changed")
    profile = CASE_PROFILES[case]
    if case == "yellow_non_alone" and (not scene.get("companion_signal_id") or
                                       not scene.get("companion_device_sha256") or
                                       not scene.get("companion_route_binding_sha256")):
        raise ConstructionError("companion indication source missing")
    if case == "red_other_route" and (not scene.get("other_route_signal_id") or
                                      not scene.get("other_route_id") or
                                      not scene.get("other_route_device_sha256")):
        raise ConstructionError("other-route official signal source missing")
    adapter.configure_world(scene["map_sha256"], fixed_delta_seconds=0.05)
    ego = adapter.spawn_ego(scene["ego_blueprint"], scene["approach_spawn"])
    signal = adapter.bind_official_signal(scene["selected_signal_id"], scene["selected_route_id"])
    if not signal or signal.get("kind") != "vehicular" or signal.get("facing_route_id") != scene["selected_route_id"]:
        raise ConstructionError("Native official signal readback failed")
    adapter.program_signal(signal, sequence=("green", "yellow", "red"), profile=profile["entry_phase"])
    if case == "red_other_route":
        other = adapter.bind_other_route_signal(scene["other_route_signal_id"],
                                                scene["other_route_id"])
        if (not other or other.get("official") is not True or
            other.get("facing_route_id") != scene["other_route_id"] or
            other.get("source_sha256") != scene["other_route_device_sha256"]):
            raise ConstructionError("other-route Native signal readback failed")
        adapter.program_other_route_signal(other, state="red")
    if case == "yellow_non_alone":
        companion = adapter.bind_companion_signal(scene["companion_signal_id"],
                                                  scene["selected_route_id"])
        if (not companion or companion.get("official") is not True or
            companion.get("facing_route_id") != scene["selected_route_id"] or
            companion.get("source_sha256") != scene["companion_device_sha256"]):
            raise ConstructionError("companion Native readback failed")
        adapter.program_companion_signal(companion, active_during="yellow")
    adapter.set_route_controller(ego, scene["route_waypoints"], behavior=profile["behavior"])
    for camera in CAMERAS:
        adapter.attach_camera(ego, camera)
    return {"case": case, "ego": ego, "signal": signal, "duration_frames": 900,
            "rate_hz": 20, "cameras": list(CAMERAS), "physical_outcome": "unverified"}
